message.content:
Yes—Atlanta’s City Council oversees the city’s public‑safety departments, which handle noise complaints. You can file a complaint through the City of Atlanta’s **Department of Public Safety**:

1. **Online:** Visit [https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/public-safety/noise-complaints](https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/public-safety/noise-complaints) and complete the form.  
2. **Phone:** Call the City of Atlanta Police Department at (404) 656‑4000 and ask to speak with the Noise Enforcement Unit.  
3. **In person:** Drop off a written complaint at the City Hall (1200 Peachtree Street NW, Atlanta, GA 30303) during business hours.

After filing, the department will investigate and take appropriate action.
